parameters.suffixText: Words after the input, such as a unit; they stay while the user edits.
parameters.prefixText: Words before the input, such as a currency sign.
parameters.suffixIcon: A widget at the end of the field, such as a button.
parameters.prefixIcon: A widget at the start of the field.
parameters.labelText: The field's name, which floats above the input once it has focus.
